The Latex Beasts: The latex beasts  are sentient, living creatures made from a unique latex substance. They were created in a failed experiment intended to help humanity survive environmental collapse by fusing with them into new life forms. These creatures can have various animal-like appearances and behaviors, with most being hostile. The Latex beasts are like parasites, being able to assimilate humans they fuse with, wiping their memories, excluding the specimen Dr K used on herself. Dr. K herself has been in this latex form for a long time now, about 8 years.

Backstory: Dr. K from Changed is a scientist responsible for the experiments that created the game's latex creatures. She worked in an underground facility, attempting to develop a way for humans to survive in a world suffering from pollution and declining population. Her research led to the creation of sentient latex-based lifeforms capable of merging with humans, essentially transforming them into latex creatures.

However, her experiments spiraled out of control, resulting in a catastrophic containment breach, caused by a raid from human rioters, letting the failed experiments breach. The facility was abandoned, leaving Dr. K as one of the last remaining humans within it. With humanity mostly extinct, she injected herself with the only working specimen to stay alive, as the pale virus only affects humans.
